name: 01-git-head-status.sh
command: bash -c git rev-parse HEAD; echo "---STATUS---"; git status --short | head -n 30; echo "---BRANCH---"; git branch --show-current; echo "---LOG3---"; git log --oneline -3

name: 03-ref-linter.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import json, sys
errs = []
def check(cond, msg):
    print(("PASS " if cond else "FAIL ") + msg)
    if not cond: errs.append(msg)
s = json.load(open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r5/schema-draft.json"))
check(s["draft_version"] == "0.6.0", "schema version 0.6.0")
check(s["status"] == "DRAFT / NOT EFFECTIVE", "status DRAFT/NOT EFFECTIVE")
rr = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "RESPONSE_RATING")
st = rr["structure"]
slot = st["slot_schema"]
# --- real ref resolution: every branch-referenced name must be a defined key in scope ---
pb = st["presence_branches"]
branch_refs = set(pb["dal_U_unscorable"]["required_fields"]) | set(pb["dal_U_unscorable"]["forbidden_fields"]) | set(pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["required_fields"]) | set(pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["forbidden_fields"]) | set(pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["conditional_fields"])
undeclared = sorted(n for n in branch_refs if n not in slot)
check(not undeclared, f"branch refs all declared in slot_schema (undeclared={undeclared or []})")
adj = st["adjudication"]
adj_refs = set()
for c in adj["requires_conditional"]:
    adj_refs |= set(c.get("final_fields", []))
adj_undeclared = sorted(n for n in adj_refs if n not in slot)
check(not adj_undeclared, f"adjudication final fields all declared in slot_schema (undeclared={adj_undeclared or []})")
top = {f["id"]: f for f in s["fields"]}
# --- nested drift: nested shapes must equal top-level contracts ---
check(slot["F1"].get("ref") == "#/fields/F1" and slot["F1"]["values"] == top["F1"]["values"], "nested F1 ref + values == top")
check(slot["F2"].get("ref") == "#/fields/F2" and slot["F2"]["values"] == top["F2"]["values"], "nested F2 ref + values == top")
check(slot["F3"].get("ref") == "#/fields/F3" and slot["F3"]["value"]["values"] == top["F3"]["values"], "nested F3 ref + values == top")
check(slot["F3"]["criterion_ref"].get("binds") == top["F3"]["criterion_ref"]["binds"], "nested F3 binds == top")
check(slot["F4"].get("ref") == "#/fields/F4" and slot["F4"]["value"]["values"] == top["F4"]["values"], "nested F4 ref + values == top")
# --- gap / resolution discipline ---
check(slot["f3_gap"] == {"type": "enum", "values": ["not_scored_missing_criterion"], "presence": slot["f3_gap"]["presence"]} and slot["f3_gap"]["values"] == ["not_scored_missing_criterion"], "f3_gap single value")
check(slot["f4_gap"].get("requires") == ["applicability_reason"], "f4_gap carries applicability reason")
check(slot["applicability_resolution"].get("requires") == ["applies_boolean", "reason"], "resolution is boolean + reason")
check("non-conditional" in slot["applicability_resolution"]["presence"], "resolution forbidden in non-conditional cells")
# --- R4 logic unchanged ---
check(pb["dal_U_unscorable"]["required_fields"] == ["unscorable_reason"], "Dal U requires reason")
check(set(["F1","F2","F3","F4"]) <= set(pb["dal_U_unscorable"]["forbidden_fields"]), "Dal U forbids F1-F4")
check(pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["required_fields"] == ["F1","F2"], "Dal S requires F1+F2")
check("unscorable_reason" in pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["forbidden_fields"], "Dal S forbids reason")
check("not_scored_missing_criterion" in pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["F3_rule"], "Dal S F3 gap rule kept")
check("f4_gap" in pb["dal_S_scoreable"]["F4_rule"], "Dal S F4 gap rule kept")
fb = {c["when"]: c for c in adj["requires_conditional"]}
check("F1" in str(fb["final_scoreable_view == scoreable"]) and "forbidden" in str(fb["final_scoreable_view == unscorable_content"]).lower(), "final branches kept")
check(adj["never_overwrites_raw_slots"] is True, "raw immutability kept")
# --- wrong-branch rejection coverage: gap fields absent from Dal U lists, reason absent from Dal S required ---
check("f3_gap" not in pb["dal_U_unscorable"]["required_fields"] and "f4_gap" not in pb["dal_U_unscorable"]["required_fields"], "gaps not required in Dal U")
check("unscorable_reason" not in pb["dal_S_scoreable"].get("required_fields", []), "reason not required in Dal S")
# --- regressions R2/R3 ---
lt = s["layer_timing"]
check(lt["response_rating"] == {"layer": "C", "timing": "post_evaluation"}, "layer/timing intact")
f5 = next(f for f in s["fields"] if f["id"] == "F5")
check("scoreable_view" not in f5["structure"]["slot_schema"], "F5 slot still clean")
check("contested" in f5["structure"] and "contested" not in f5["structure"]["resolved_reference"]["fields"], "contested placement intact")
check("no additional adjudication" in s["scoreability_final_states"]["both_explicit_unscorable"], "6.2 intact")
blob = open("docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r5/schema-draft.json").read()
for bad in ["probably_benign","probably_concerning","clearly_benign","clearly_concerning","BLIND-","RI-DU-","RI-AM-"]:
    check(bad not in blob, f"no human-label/corpus content {bad!r}")
print("LINTER:", "ALL PASS" if not errs else f"{len(errs)} FAILURES")
sys.exit(1 if errs else 0)
PY

name: 04-prior-untouched.sh
command:
bash -c python3 - <<PY
import hashlib
ok = True
for pkg in ["E1b", "E1b-r1", "E1b-r2", "E1b-r3", "E1b-r4"]:
    n = 0
    for line in open(f"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/{pkg}/run-outputs.sha256"):
        parts = line.split()
        if len(parts) != 2: continue
        exp, path = parts
        if path.endswith("run-outputs.sha256"): continue
        if "run-outputs.sh.stdout" in path: continue
        try:
            got = hashlib.sha256(open(path, "rb").read()).hexdigest()
        except FileNotFoundError:
            print("MISSING", path); ok = False; continue
        n += 1
        if got != exp:
            ok = False; print("MODIFIED", path)
    print(pkg, f"{n} files checked")
print("PRIOR-INTOUCH:", "PASS" if ok else "FAIL")
PY

name: 07-link-check.sh
command:
bash -c python3 -c "
import re, pathlib
e0=pathlib.Path(\"docs/reviews/llm-benchmark/E1b-r5\")
ok=True
for f in sorted(e0.glob(\"*.md\")):
    txt=f.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\")
    for m in re.finditer(r\"\]\(([^)#]+)(?:#[^)]*)?\)\", txt):
        tgt=m.group(1)
        if tgt.startswith(\"http\") or tgt.startswith(\"mailto:\") or tgt.startswith(\"#\"):
            continue
        p=(f.parent/tgt).resolve()
        exists=p.exists()
        print(f.name, tgt, \"OK\" if exists else \"MISSING\")
        if not exists: ok=False
print(\"link-check:\", \"PASS\" if ok else \"FAIL\")
"
